_doc: Arena tape (mm). Our frame: corner C4 = (0,0), x to the right (east), y up (north). Robot heading 0 = east, CCW positive. Source: NRL 2026 manual + team measurements; ASSUMPTION items are marked.

START.source: 500x500 (manual); START edge to C1 = 300 mm (measured). Centred on the bottom line = ASSUMPTION

PARK.source: 500x500 (manual); C4 to PARK edge = 300 mm (measured). Centred on the bottom line = ASSUMPTION

bottom_line.source: line from START to C1 and from C4 to PARK. The piece between PARK and START is not on any route and is omitted (ASSUMPTION)

terminal_source: manual: terminals 500 mm with 150 mm end bars; pick-ups point outward at 500/1500 mm from the corners on the right, top and left sides; drops point inward at the side midpoints

field.source: manual: 3658 x 3658 mm field; loop centred in it = ASSUMPTION

start_pose.source: chassis middle at the centre of START, facing C1 (ASSUMPTION: the team's placement)
